title: Fibre-generic locus of a flat finitely presented morphism is stable under generalization
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a flat finitely presented morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Here finitely presented means locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. For $s\in S$ let $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ be the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Let $G_f\subseteq |X|$ be the union, over $s\in S$, of the images of the generic points of the irreducible components of $X_s$ [def-weil-irreducible-components]; a generic point of a closed irreducible subset is a point whose closure is that subset. If $x\in G_f$ and $x\in\overline{\{x^{\prime}\}}$ in $X$, then $x^{\prime}\in G_f$.

source.place: Lemma 3.5.3, printed pp. 20--21. Primary PDF read online; local archival copy WANTED.
